title: Wax Impressionism
description: Un style d'illustration naïf et vibrant imitant le crayon de cire épais ou le pastel à l'huile sur papier texturé à gros grain. Il repose sur des hachures directionnelles agressives et un mélange optique des couleurs plutôt que sur des fondus, créant une surface très tactile.
description_en: A vibrant, naive illustration style mimicking heavy wax crayon or oil pastel on coarse textured paper. It relies on aggressive, directional hatching and optical color mixing rather than smooth blending, creating a highly tactile, energetic surface.
description_fr: Un style d'illustration naïf et vibrant imitant le crayon de cire épais ou le pastel à l'huile sur papier texturé à gros grain. Il repose sur des hachures directionnelles agressives et un mélange optique des couleurs plutôt que sur des fondus, créant une surface très tactile.
prompt: Heavy wax crayon and oil pastel illustration. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The image must occupy the absolute entire dedicated space: no borders, no frames, no white margins, full bleed to all four corners. The rendering technique relies entirely on aggressive, directional hatching, energetic scribbles, and thick scumbling applied with heavy hand pressure. There is absolutely no seamless blending or digital smoothing; instead, colors mix optically through adjacent, expressive strokes of dry media. Use {{primary_color}} as the dominant structural base, heavily accented by vibrant, saturated patches of {{accent_color}} and supported by dense clusters of {{secondary_color}}. The materiality is highly tactile and raw, explicitly revealing a heavy, coarse paper tooth that breaks up the granular dry-media falloff, leaving negative space between strokes. Lighting is distinctly flat and ambient, implied purely by sharp color value shifts and clustered darker strokes rather than realistically rendered gradients or volumetric shadows. Subject contours are unrefined, ragged, and feathered, defined by the kinetic termination of thick crayon marks rather than continuous outlines. The spatial dynamics feature a slightly flattened, stacked perspective typical of naive art, creating a warm, energetic, post-impressionist atmosphere. Every element is built from discrete, visible marks, generating a vibrant rhythm across the composition. Tags: wax crayon, oil pastel, directional hatching, heavy paper tooth, post-impressionism, tactile, naive art, dry media, unblended strokes, textured canvas, flat lighting, full bleed, edge-to-edge, no border, no frame

video.motion: Strokes redraw continuously in a boiling effect, mimicking stop-motion pastel animation. Subjects move with a slight jitter, maintaining the naive, hand-drawn aesthetic.
video.camera: Static or slow, stepped panning that mimics a multiplane camera moving over a flat textured canvas.
video.temporal_texture: The heavy paper tooth remains locked in screen space while the granular crayon strokes boil and shift dynamically on top of it.
video.avoid: Smooth interpolations, 3D camera sweeps, motion blur, and seamless digital gradients.
